text:
Your emotions aren't automatic. You build them.

You think your feelings are facts. Motivation comes or it doesn't. Enthusiasm is for lucky people.

Wrong.

The seven emotions: desire, faith, love, s*x, enthusiasm, romance, hope. You practice them into habit through deliberate self talk.

Most men wait for feelings. They never arrive.

You can build every single one starting today. Pick one. Practice it daily.

Build your emotions like you build muscle.
caption:
Your emotions aren't luck. They're built through daily practice. Mindset and discipline are habits you construct, not gifts you receive. Send this to a man who needs it today.
